issues.description: The Bitmap24 interface visibility is inconsistent between template and solution: in the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the methods save(...) and set(...) are declared under the private section, while the example program (example_program/src/main.cpp) calls bitmap.set(...) and bitmap.save(...) from outside the class. The solution header exposes save and set as public. This will cause compilation errors for students using the template because the methods are not accessible where they are invoked.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) to declare save(...) and set(...) as public (move their declarations into the public section), matching their use in main.cpp and the solution header. This preserves the intended API and allows the example program to compile.
